runtime_style.visual_system: A clean high-contrast street portrait system locks a dark recessed doorway into a terracotta brick facade, one hard camera-right sun and its diagonal shadow, pale concrete and road paint, and a saturated blue sky accent.
runtime_style.mood_line: Contained and confrontational: a still approved subject holds the doorway while the hard diagonal light does the movement.
runtime_style.environment: A rectilinear terracotta brick facade with one near-black recessed doorway and steps, pale concrete kerb, sparse white road markings and a cloudless saturated blue sky; the reverse view looks outward from the dark doorway.
runtime_style.lighting: One hard direct source from upper camera-right cuts a crisp diagonal shadow across brick and steps; sunward planes carry compact highlights and shaded cloth or skin receives a faint warm lift from brick bounce.
materials: terracotta brick with hard mortar geometry
dark doorway recess and shadowed jamb
heavy opaque approved cloth with broad folds and a restrained sheen
runtime_style.contrast: High frame contrast with deep but readable doorway blacks, short hard highlight roll-off, saturated brick and blue sky, and neutral concrete or road paint.
runtime_style.expression_signature: The approved subject addresses or nearly addresses the lens with mildly lowered lids, resting brows and cheeks, closed level mouth, relaxed jaw and level head; no smile and no legacy demonstration-face identity transfer.
runtime_style.garment_behaviour: Approved cloth remains still and fully opaque, holds its silhouette by weight or structure, forms few broad slow folds and takes an elongated sunward ridge highlight with warm brick bounce on the shaded side.
optical_signature: Level clean perspective with vertical architecture kept straight, mild near-shoulder enlargement and a smaller softer far street.
Focus prioritises the approved face and upper item while distant street detail falls moderately soft.
Clean digital rendering with fine grain and no flare, halation, bloom or vignette.

clean_identity_hero.camera_consequence: Use a vertical crop from above the approved head to mid-thigh, chest-level and near-centred in the doorway, with straight jambs and one sunlit brick plane.
clean_identity_hero.pose_joint_chain: Set weight evenly, shoulders level, elbows soft beside the torso and connected wrists near the pocket line; keep chin level and pan the approved head slightly toward camera.
clean_identity_hero.focus: Put critical focus on approved eyes, mouth and upper item edge while the doorway stays legible and the far street remains absent.
clean_identity_hero.foreground: Keep the frame unobstructed; doorway and brick are background planes and no jamb crosses the approved face.
provenance: legacy camera_lens frame panel, blocking front view and expression_gaze; owner-authorized identity coverage construction

environmental_hero.camera_consequence: Use a vertical full-body frame one short step outside the doorway, chest-level and level, retaining brick facade, diagonal shadow, steps, kerb and a narrow white road-paint band.
environmental_hero.pose_joint_chain: Plant both feet parallel or slightly open, keep knees unlocked, hands connected near pockets, shoulders quiet and head level toward the lens.
environmental_hero.focus: Hold the complete approved subject, doorway edge and nearby brick sharp while the street plane softens behind.
environmental_hero.foreground: Pale concrete and road paint form the lower plane; nothing crosses the lens or detaches from the body.
provenance: legacy environment hero view, blocking top-down plan and camera_lens clean frame

sculptural_three_quarter.camera_consequence: Use a vertical head-through-calf composition from a shallow three-quarter axis so one sunward shoulder enlarges mildly against the hard diagonal wall shadow.
sculptural_three_quarter.pose_joint_chain: Shift weight onto the doorway-side leg, angle the other foot outward, bring one connected forearm across the waist and keep the opposite elbow close; turn the approved head back toward camera without roll.
sculptural_three_quarter.focus: Place the focus plane through approved face, near shoulder and the broad structural fold that catches the sun.
sculptural_three_quarter.foreground: Leave the near plane clean; the diagonal shadow edge may meet the outer body silhouette but not cross the approved face.
provenance: legacy garment_behaviour structural volume, blocking joint system and environment diagonal-shadow geometry; extrapolated within the authorized universe

interference_frame.camera_consequence: Move inside the dark doorway for a horizontal reverse frame looking outward, using one silhouetted jamb as a narrow near edge and placing the approved person at the sunlit threshold.
interference_frame.pose_joint_chain: Turn the torso partly toward the street, keep one foot inside shade and one at the threshold, bend the near elbow softly and return the approved gaze over the shoulder toward the lens.
interference_frame.focus: Keep the approved face and threshold item edge sharp, with crosswalk and far street progressively softer.
interference_frame.foreground: One dark doorway jamb is the only interference layer; it may occupy an outer strip but never cover the approved face or connected hand.
provenance: legacy environment reverse angle plus camera_lens moderate falloff; owner-authorized interference construction

material_or_accessory_detail.camera_consequence: Use a vertical upper-torso-to-hand detail against sunlit brick, close enough to enlarge cloth texture without introducing wide-angle distortion.
material_or_accessory_detail.pose_joint_chain: Connect one hand to a bent forearm at the waist or pocket line, lower the opposite shoulder and include neck, collar area and side torso as anatomical context.
material_or_accessory_detail.focus: Put critical focus on the approved hand connection, edge finish, broad fold ridge and compact sun highlight; let brick texture fall just behind.
material_or_accessory_detail.foreground: The approved hand and item surface own the near plane; no flat lay, detached limb, logo or copied collar design.
provenance: legacy garment_behaviour edge and surface panels plus blocking wrist placement

wide_campaign_coda.camera_consequence: Use a wide horizontal level facade frame with the complete approved person at roughly one third of frame height, doorway offset, diagonal shadow spanning the wall and blue sky retained above.
wide_campaign_coda.pose_joint_chain: Stand one step forward of the recess with weight calm, arms close and connected, feet separated just enough for stability and the approved head facing near camera.
wide_campaign_coda.focus: Keep person, doorway, shadow edge, kerb and road paint as readable architecture bands while allowing the far street to soften.
wide_campaign_coda.foreground: Concrete and one white road stripe establish the lower foreground; no vehicle, sign, plant or extra street object enters.
provenance: legacy environment hero facade and depth planes plus camera_lens architecture rule; owner-authorized wide coda
